briefdescription.para: Start monitoring for a Healthy Boot Monitor device transition.

detaileddescription.para: Validates the monitor index and its pending requirement, starts the timeout using the requirement's current QoS, associates the corresponding software error with the requesting subsystem, records the pending power use count, and requests power-up from the device's power domain.
The timer and error-subsystem association are established before the power event is issued and are not rolled back if that event fails.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the Healthy Boot Monitor device entering the running state. The device and its power-domain association must be valid.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if monitoring was started and any power-up event completed successfully.
XST_FAILURE if the monitor index or pending requirement is invalid.
An error status returned while starting the timer or handling the power-up event.

briefdescription.para: Stop monitoring for a Healthy Boot Monitor device transition.

detaileddescription.para: Validates the monitor index, clears its timeout, and, when the device has an associated power domain, requests a power-down event. The cleared timeout is not restored if power-down fails.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the Healthy Boot Monitor device leaving the running state. Must not be NULL.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if the timer was stopped and any power-down event completed successfully.
XST_FAILURE if the monitor index is outside the timeout table.
An error status returned by the power-down event handler.
